description: Agent Onboarding: submit the record a new agent’s onboarding leaves behind and what is live: optionally the agent with its id and name; the record with its id, who approved the setup, when, when the agent’s first task ran, everything it says was granted, each with its item (such as orders API read) and kind (a permission, a credential, a wallet, a limit, a system or other), when the setup is next reviewed and who reviews it; everything actually live for the agent now, read from its systems, each with its item and kind (an empty list when nothing is); and when the live state was read. The signed report gives the record, every recorded item as live, not_live or unread, every live item as recorded, unrecorded or unread, and counts the items recorded, live, recorded and live, live but unrecorded and recorded but no longer live, and names a missing record: no approver, approval date or grant list, approval by the agent itself or by a placeholder, approval after the first task ran and a live item missing from the record; then a recorded item no longer live, no review date, an overdue review and no named reviewer, with the fix for each. No live state, no read date and no first-task date leave the record unverifiable. This reads the record one onboarding leaves behind against what is live: whether a registry covers every deployed agent is wever_agent-registry-check, whether one roster is kept current as agents come and go is wever_fleet-roster-check, whether an approval record holds the exact call is wever_approval-record-check, whether recorded actions can be attributed to an agent under an authorization is wever_actor-attribution-check, stored permission grants and revocations are wever_agent-permission-ledger and a consent’s ledger entry is wever_consent-record-check. Verdict onboarding_record_missing, onboarding_record_incomplete, onboarding_record_unverifiable or onboarding_record_complete. POST /api/onboarding-record-check. Reads only the recorded onboarding material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, configuration change or external write; no credential is issued, rotated or revoked, no permission granted or removed, no wallet funded or moved, no limit set and the agent is not approved, and a credential found in supplied text is named by kind and never repeated. Agent Onboarding reads the setup of a new agent joining a system, before its first task: whether its identity is established and tied to its owner, whether its credentials are scoped to its job, stored where they belong and kept out of prompts, logs and shared documents, whether its wallet is the right one, funded only to the job with recovery recorded by the owner before funds move, whether its permissions match the written job, whether its limits sit in code with a human handoff, whether the systems it needs are provisioned and tested, whether it is ready for its first task and whether the onboarding record matches what is live. It is not vetting an outside party (wever_counterparty-onboarding-check reads a counterparty’s onboarding packet before the system transacts with it; an onboarding check reads an agent joining the system itself), not a grant or an authority for one action (wever_consent-scope-check reads whether a principal’s grant covers a use and wever_authority-scope-check whether an actor’s access fits its grant for an action; an onboarding check reads that the grant and the authority were put in place before the first task, and does not re-check them per action), not a limit in flight (the wever_limit checks and wever_agent-budget-guard read limits for work already running; an onboarding check reads that limits were set in code before it starts) and not an action’s consequences (the wever_risk checks read one planned action; an onboarding check reads readiness to start). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-onboarding-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-onboarding/.
